Unreleased/Fixed bullet per §16

tests.asserts: one entry's worktree dir held + other entries pickable → held slug quarantined after its first failure, remaining entries work to batch completion; identical failure signature 3x consecutive with no success between → run aborts non-zero naming the signature; a failure that clears next tick neither quarantines beyond the run nor trips the backstop
